t: Aho, aho... What brings you here, stupid hyt? I hate being bothered over nothing, eysh! Brring it on, and get lost!

How dare you bother over such a stupid thing?! Though wait...

What a weird feeling. It's as if the stone was shivering. And the crystal of the old Portal responds to it, eysh!

Maybe this is the key that I've been looking for all these years? I take my words back. You are giving me hope!

Faith is not our only weapon against the darkness, but it is the best one. Each one who has went through the trials carries a particle of the Light inside of them, but very few can use it like you do! It is a special power that you faith endows you with. Soon I will tell you where its source is. For now, look here, eysh!

This amulet contains a dark spirit. I carry it with me all the time to remember that the Darkness is always near, and we always have to keep our eyes wide open. Only our faith can beat the spirit. Use it to drive it back into the amulet.

Don't be scared of it. Think of the Light that you carry in your heart and in your hands. The spirit loathes you more than anything in the world, but it fears your power even more.
I am Saad-Yuha the Merciful, the Watcher of the Priden history. What brings you to me, child?
[You find a small novel about vampires on her belt. It looks like she came here... voluntarily? At least there won’t be any more victims.]
The girl was killed very recently. Strangely, her body bears no signs of a struggle...

Our world did not know wars. For millions of years the tribes lived in harmony with each other. It all started only recently... Darkness has been able to find its way into our world, and its deeds are truly grim.

But the worst happened when you came to our world. And started to cut down the forest, kill animals. At first, we didn't know how to react. However, after some time, Rhubarb found a solution. Aliens from another world, he reasoned, were no different from natural disasters or animals behaving aggressively. And therefore, it is necessary to fight them in the same way - to select hunters who will deal with this disaster.

However, you are more dangerous than any animal in this world. Your greed and malice are unparalleled, so the hunters have become real warriors. Protectors of our Eden.
h: Hello, what do you do here?

t: What, did he use his tail to help and protect us? That’s nonsense! His paws were strong and spectacular! Large as tree trunks and skilled as... as... you know, really skilled! Paws are important!
See, he did have the paws! And the rest, of course. Let’s start the construction!
h: Tell them what Genlun looks like

t: Yes, yes, I ran into demons and their servants back in the days when most of you never even heard of them! We should have been on our guard, but everyone was lulled by the tranquility of those peaceful years...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: If we knew the trick with which can overcome the Void... But this enemy will not retreat or show mercy. Like an incoming tide, its waves are now attacking our lands.

Howlem is only a part of what used to be. The First were born when the creator of all living things began to transform the earth. For three centuries he created animals, fish and birds, but as soon as the first living beings were endowed with sentience, we, the First, also awakened. There were many of us, but everything in the world comes to an end.

We always have to sacrifice something. The good of many is greater than the good of one...

This is a true miracle - I can see now how kind Mistress can be. I wish we got any wiser from the good! But no, the likes of us can never get enough.

As the evil spirits got quiet, diggers started to dig and miners started to mine wherever they wanted, deeper and deeper into the mountain, greedier and greedier! Goldie tried and reasoned them, but they just won’t listen! They said, if Mistress ever shows up again, the chief will invite even a stronger hero to take her on a leash! So, we played our way into trouble, that got her angry! Boy, was that a scary night! Howl, and rumble, and cries of horror! And then it was all gone, disappeared. I’m the one who managed to survive - evidently, I haven’t sinned as much as others! That’s right, I never dig, just sit around and pray to the Light all day...

Shall we pray for the peace of their souls?

We were going to the demonic portal when we heard this song. Oh, Tensess, it was so beautiful! Tears came to our eyes as we listened... It was like a mother's song over the cradle... So sad... So touching... We heard it with out hearts!

It's a song about everything we lost.

I'm a hermit now. I came to Eljune, and heard this song again as I was walking along the shore.

Go... and listen! It's somewhere close by... It's wandering imperceptibly, and only those who can listen will hear it.

These are all of your different devices.

Artillery is a stationary weapon located at ship's bow. It deals huge damage if used properly. After activation, it inflicts more and more damage over time, but also consumes more energy and may cause overheating.

In ship-to-ship combat, artillery is most effective against shields, and least effective against hull. Artillery always inflicts huge damage to astral creatures.

Regular artillery is well-balanced and inflicts medium damage at a little risk of overheating.

Large Artillery is a long-range model. It consumes more energy and inflicts about the same amount of damage, but its range is higher.

Compact Artillery is a short-range model which inflicts a lot of damage on a short distance at low energy cost.

Pulsating Artillery is a shield-piercing weapon. It inflicts huge damage to shields, but its energy consumption increases rapidly. They are not effective in long-lasting battles or against hulls.

Focused Artillery is a "drill" for enemy devices. It inflicts low damage at first and is ineffective against hull, but the damage grows rapidly, slightly overheating the reactor. Focused Artillery quickly destroys ship equipment, rendering it helpless.

Advanced Artillery is a heavy-weight model that inflicts more damage and consume more energy than the regular one.

Charged Artillery consumes a lot of energy, but inflict the highest amount of damage across non-specialized models.

Cannons represent main ship armament. Up to 16 cannons can be installed on a ship, 8 on a lower deck and 8 on an upper deck. When choosing a cannon, several parameters should be considered:

Damage dealt by a cannon is directly proportional to the energy it uses, but if the energy consumption is too high, the damage will increase slowly.

Rapid-firing cannons are very efficient and deal significant damage over time, however, heavy-caliber cannons deal more damage per salvo.

Depending on a model, cannons deal Fire, Astral, Lightning or Acid damage. Astral demons always receive full damage, but enemy ships do not.

Fire damage is equally efficient against shields, hulls, and devices. It has no special features.

Astral damage is very effective against shields, but useless against hull.

Acid damage has low efficiency against shields, but it destroys hulls quickly and is deadly to enemy crew.

Lightning damage does not affect hulls and has normal efficiency against shields, but it disables enemy devices rapidly. Also, each successful hit reduces movement speed of the target.

Keep in mind that there are cannons that inflict damage in a 120 yard radius. They are very effective against groups of weaker demons, but such shots consume a lot of energy.

A fully equipped ship has the following devices installed: reactor, motor, helm, turbine, visor, scanner, six shields, two artilleries and 16 cannons. Devices are maintained by three Goblin Repairmen. I will tell you about the devices in detail. But for now, here's the basics.

Each device class has several types. For example, there are long-ranged cannons and rapid-firing cannons. Each type is most efficient for a specific purpose.

Device performance depends on its rarity and generation (I, II, III etc.). Within each generation there are devices of standard (most common), rare (improved), and epic (highly efficient and very difficult to obtain) quality. Newer generations represent a significant boost in efficiency. For instance, a standard second generation device is similar to epic equipment of the first generation.
Equipping a ship is a challenge in itself. Durability, speed and combat characteristics of your ship depend on your choices. Let's start from the beginning.

Motor is the source of moving power. Its main stats are speed, acceleration, and weight load. If your ship is overloaded, its speed decreases.

Regular motors maintain decent speed and consume energy at a standard rate. They do not have any special advantages.

Bolstered Motors are slower, but they allow carrying heavy weights and consume less energy.

Stream-Lined Motors are fast, but they consume more energy and support only a standard weight load. If you installed one, make sure not to overload your reactor.

High-Speed Motors have increased energy consumption rate. They can carry heavy weight at a medium speed and provide the best acceleration.

Reinforced Motors can boast of top speed, acceleration, and load weight at the same time, but they also have the highest energy consumption rate. When moving at full speed, your reactor may become overheated.

Swift Motors have top speed, acceleration, and load weight, and their energy consumption rate is standard, but they cannot carry heavy weights, so better use them at lighter ships.

Turbine allows you to change your ship's altitude through a series of propulsions varying in strength and duration. Stronger impulses make you ship move faster. Such maneuvering allows to evade attacks of enemy ships or escape Astral demons.

Regular Turbines maintain medium strength and duration of impulses.

Reinforced Turbines have greater strength and duration of impulses.

Stream-Lined Turbines have maximum impulse strength, but its duration is standard. It allows you to quickly move your ship upwards or downwards, but within a small range.

Bolstered Turbines have maximum impulse duration which allows you to change altitude within greater range.

Goblins can fix equipment damaged in a fight or in an accident. Goblins vary in action radius and repair duration. The longer a goblin works, the more damage will be repaired.

Goblin Tinkerer can repair equipment located far away, but only works for a short period of time. Use it to repair several slightly damaged devices.

Goblin Mechanic repairs equipment located in a medium range and works for a standard period of time.

Goblin Repairman fixes equipment in a small range (only 1 or 2 nearest pieces), but for a longer period of time. It can repair a completely disabled device and keep it operational under enemy fire.

Visor is a device used for maneuvering and navigation within an Astral region. Not only Visor keeps you informed on a course of travel and combat, but also has various special functions.

Visors are not divided into types, instead each model is given a unique set of functions. For example, let's have a look at advanced Visors:

Pirate's Cooling and Balancing Visor is useful in fights against large packs of Astral monsters, as well as in regular exploration. However, it does not have Sharp Turn and Energy Discharge functions.

Pirate's Cooling and Reversal Visor is less convenient for traveling because of a missing Shield Boost option, but its Sharp Turn ability is helpful in combat against other ships or single demons.

Cooling, Balancing, and Reversal Visor has a greater variety of functions ensuring its effectiveness in fights against single demons or packs. However, it does not have Diversionary Shot and Local Jump abilities useful for rapid movement.

Pirate's Balancing and Reversal Visor is effective in longer fights against single targets, where the absence of Intense Cooling and Energy Discharge abilities is not crucial.

The reactor is the heart of a ship. It supplies all equipment with energy. If the reactor is disabled, the ship cannot move, attack or defend itself.

The reactor channels energy from surrounding Astral to ship equipment. High load may overheat it, causing energy bursts and shutdowns.

Important stats of a reactor are maximum load, which shows how much heat it is guaranteed to stand, and cooling capacity, which indicates how much heat is dissipated per second.

A regular reactor has standard consumption rate, a good balance of durability, load and cooling rate.

"Pulse" Reactor has higher cooling rate, but its maximum load is lower, so energy bursts are not uncommon. It can easily deal with medium energy consumption, but higher loads may cause overheating and malfunctioning.

"Athlete" Reactor has high maximum load, but its cooling rate is rather low, which may cause shutdowns. It can manage extreme peak loads, but they should not be too frequent.

"The Kid" Reactor has low maximum load but its safety levels and cooling rate are very high. It can be used even when overheated.

"Cauldron" Reactor boasts of high load and good cooling rate, but it is not very safe. Operate it with care.

"Candle" Reactor has the lowest maximum load and the best cooling rate. In addition, it is fully protected from mana bursts when overheated.

"Star" Reactor has the best maximum load but low cooling rate. It never becomes disabled, which means that your ship will be provided with energy at any circumstances. It is useful for huge one-time consumption.

Helms are used to steer the ship, they are important both in combat and travels. They vary in turning speed and energy consumption. You have to decide for yourself if you want to increase maneuverability in exchange for energy payload.

Regular Helm has well-balanced stats.

Large Helm provides maximum maneuverability, but its energy consumption rate is also the highest.

Reinforced Helm provides increased maneuverability at a reasonable energy cost.

Small Helms are the slowest, and their energy consumption is extremely low.

Scanner is used to find various objects in the Astral, such as isles, wormholes, enemy ships and demons. It also plots a route to destination points, and in case of an emergency scanner can hide your ship from the most demons. All scanner operations consume Astral Emanations. There are scanners optimized for different tasks, their consumption rates vary depending on the model.

 "Watchman" Scanners are useful for traveling to Astral isles. They consume less emanations when searching for isles and routing to them.

"Sentry" Scanners are best used in combat - they consume less emanations when searching for enemies and rendering the ship invisible to demons.

"The Eye" scanners are useful for traveling between regions. They have lowered cost of searching for isles and wormholes.

Astral shields grants your ship protection from enemy attacks by absorbing incoming damage. If a shield is disabled, demonic attacks or gun shots may reach ship's hull and devices.

Shields must be switched off manually to recharge. After switching off, the shield consumes a certain amount of energy, and gradually restores to full.

The most important stat of a shield is Strength, which indicates how much damage it can endure before becoming disabled. Charge, Recovery Rate and Energy Consumption are no less important - they show how often recharging can be performed, how long it takes and how much energy it consumes.

Standard Astral Shields have balanced durability, recharge time and energy consumption.

Massive and Glittering Astral Shields have increased strength and better recharge time, but they consume a lot of energy. Make sure not to overheat your reactor, otherwise you will lose the ability to fire or recharge shields.

Pulsating and Shining Astral Shields are the strongest, they require little energy, but recharge slowly and less frequently. They can be used to absorb a high amount of damage at once, and then spend the remaining energy to kill the enemies quickly.

Resilient, Shimmering and Sparkling Shields are the least powerful but fast-recharging and economical. They are useful for absorbing steady sustainable damage, but you will have to recharge them frequently.

Embossed Astral Shields provide good protection and recharge rate at low energy consumption. They are a perfect match for powerful weaponry.

quests: Nefer Ur knows what to do

t: Greetings, explorers of space! I have the cosmonaut suits for those who wish to conquer the stars! These suits will grant you safety and style in any adventures beyond our planet. Are you ready for the flight?

I've heard a rumor here: they said there was no flight, but I and my brother simply filmed all of that in our "Illusion"! But I think you will be able to see it's not so! We're only documenting the events that have happened!

The government's conspiracy! This is all a part of the grand conspiracy to conceal the truth, clandestinely control minds and eliminating dissenters – those who are trying to get everyone else to open their eyes! By using the newest Jeb technologies, the government is spying on us to further its own plans!

I know for sure that one of the Neguses is a traitor who is sabotaging Nefer Ur's project! This is a totally credible information that I received from my own source!
h: Tell us about the things you are worried about.

t: Greetings to all of you fans of electronic sound! I have a certain something truly unique in my hands: the audio record by the band Synthetica, who has once upended the entire perception of music! It's not just an album – it's a whole universe of sonic experiments and synthesizer magics! Each song is a trip to the world where technology meets art. If you want to experience a real audial rush and become a part of the revolution in music, you really ought to have this record in your collection! And remember, treasures like these don't stay on the shelves for long – grab your copy before it's too late!

More and more curious artifacts are being discovered, including the Artifacts of Darkness – same as those on the Coba Plateau, charged with the dark energy of Tep's Plague. I’m glad to see your mind is still working. Fair justice is what makes us different from those ungodly creatures.
Well... I guess there’s no other choice. I’m glad I met you... Stormbringer. I wish I could believe that this world is not doomed in the hands of people like you... but I don’t.

The Architects are aware of our presence, yet they keep on raining fire over the place instead of facing us. Cowardly wretches!

I will cover you with a magical barrier which is supposed to protect you from the fire. Don't look at me like that! When you deal with the Architects' magic, you can be sure of nothing.

h: Say that Scar will never be the leader

t:
Can you feel it? It smells with blood!

Breathe, meat. Enjoy while you still can. Who will protect you? Why would anyone speak for you, cub? You're mine!

Hah, fools! Your understanding is so limited... I am the oldest of the Arisen, and the only one who remembers how it all really happened! I have seen the June Curse, I witnessed Peraach and Bathory, I talked with Tep and Ur... I could have told you a great deal, but I'm not going to speak to you of anything, you wretches!

The last of the created inner worlds is Eden, the world of life.

Eden was also created by the All-Mother who wanted to gift it to her beloved daughter, a goddess.

This world remained hidden, and its location was unknown for a long time, but those who visited it said the planet itself was a huge Garden of Eden, covered with many Great Trees - giant plants created by life itself.

Huh, what do you think? I'm fixing this... Elves can't hold any races without me. Who will fix their rides if they break down? Oh, sorry, not rides but "magical sledges, the latest achievement in elven engineering science". Pshaw...
This land is still in sync with the Dark God's magic.
I'm trying to understand why Lizardmen want the bird elements on this physical shape. Customs of these people are very strange.
Your quest here is completed. Do you wish to return?
Ah, this Petrusha Grinev, that scoundrel... He seduced Masha away from me, and he aims to be a hero... But that's fine, I'll show him what's what.
Good afternoon! So, what's new in the White Fortress?

The White Fortress has been recaptured? That's great news. The reinforcement must be on the way!

Soldiers, listen to my command!
h: Report on the state of things

t: Is this a check?.. I report: access level prohibits the security guards to be aware of any experiments held at the secure facility!

Ay woe! Misery stretched its wings of despair over Dersaadet! Our Sultan, may the Lord give him a live of thousand years, has suddenly disappeared! He went to say his morning prayers, and we've never seen him since! Now there's a magic dome over the mosque, and it won't let anyone in or out! Nobody knows what goes on inside.

Janizary took their chance and started robbing and murdering people. Their leader, main bandit, is Rustem Aga, may the heaven and hell curse him forever!

And look at the high tower, where Sultan's daughter Guzel lives! Look at it! There's green magic fog, that looks like a viper! It's hurling malediction upon all of us!

Grief and despair!

Greetings! Yes, I have left Eden as well. I don’t understand why anyone asks the question: whether the Arisen are capable of feelings... For years and years, I have been searching for my beloved Nefertiti... But I was unable to find her either in this world or any other... What am I supposed to do, how do I become reunited with her, what is the unfortunate reason for my inability to find her - and for my suffering? You know, it is easy to start believing in almighty Fate that governs every creature's destiny! What kind of life has it ordained for me?
...Zem shrugs her shoulders and loses interest in you.

Ah, my dearmy darling, have you come to me seeking advice? A funny time you chose for that! Once, I was the icon of beauty and grace, but now, I have to depend on a mangirl like you... Records of my memories about seducing the most affluent people of my age are on this flash drive. And yes, there are a few "amusing" moments involving the Peraachs and their favorite hobbies. Don't forget that if you're going to examine my past, you need to be prepared for some shocking revelations!

t:
What? What do you mean, cheated?

I didn't lie to anyone. What are you even talking about? What doppelganger? That's nonsense.

I'm not going to discuss it.
h: You cheated your comrades! You've got a twin.

t:
Oh... You're right. I'm sick. But it's not that I had much choice.

I'm caught in a trap, I can't walk out.

It's all the scientist's fault. Everykin's. It was his idea all along.
h: Listen, aren't you sick of fooling around?

t: There's the sun shining above us. It's a beautiful life!
We see powerful progress. We see miracles!
It's all good. I'm walking around, enjoying myself. That pioneer camp is such a boring place
Sergey Syroezhkin It's nice to meet you! Perhaps you can tell me something interesting about the city?
I'm looking for interesting places. Do you know if there are any attractions?
Oh, hello! So you managed to get out of the camp, too? It's awfully dull, right?
I'm a lucky man, you see? There's a vacancy. Some seniors fall in battle, others are thrown out of saddle.
Goodbye! I'm sure we'll meet another day...

quests: Crossing over to the Valley of Shadows

t: What?! I can smell living flesh! What are these doing here?!

Kyros-shmyros! You can't just walk in here! It's the Purgatory, not a thoroughfare!

There was no Kyros in here. I would remember a name like that...

Wait. What is that noise?
Are you leaving? Because you should!

Oh, we didn’t expect we would end up here this late in life... But now we've heard everything, we know how Isa was found... Well, the tale is sad, but that's usually how it happens. It is a pity that our sons, Frank, Asgerd and Sam, brought false news, but that wasn't intentional - the broken Threads were a spell - they would have deceived anyone.

But enough grieving... We have already mourned the dead, and now a new time is coming for my people. What was torn has been restored - who knows what fate awaits us now?
Well? Are we going to Ferris? I visited it once, before the construction of the facility... It's a dismal place...

Power does not coexist with untruth, sacrifice is not caused by untruth. They'll rise without summons, go forth without call, with sacrifice boundless, each giving his all! A host they will gather of strength unsurpassed, With infinite courage will fight to the last.

We, the wardens, are the closest to nature. For our devotion we are generously rewarded with powerful nature magic. I can tell more about it to another shaman or huntmaster, who has proved loyalty to Nature.

The Kingdom of Nature is a secret allod that only the wardens can reach - the druids, animists, huntmasters and shamans. That is where we gather magic reagents that are used to brew special potions. I can teach you the secret of how to get there.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t:
I am you as you are me as I am you and you are me.

The echo is jumping between you and the reflection, like a racing glare. I, and you, and it, and we, all the words lost their meaning, they echo one another.

The face looks like a reflection in a distorted mirror. It looks puzzled and empty. It's studying you as closely as you're studying it.

This face looks familiar.

The twin nods at the pillar of Light.

Go to the Light and wait until you're given a choice. The Darkness awaits at the gate that must be closed forever.
h: How do you reject the Light?

t: What is there to tell? We can live here in peace or visit to make our powerful potions.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t:
Oh, hello! There you are, the hero of this celebration! We've heard about you so much over the year...

Well, the Winter Watch is over... Now we want to travel...

We are composing another story! About the grandma - Mauni the Dancer! Have you heard that story? Well, perhaps you'll hear it soon...

Oh, hello, hello! We knew we'd meet you here! All we've done this whole year is travel! We've been to Lightwood, Izune, Forox, and even Lugna! It's a shame you weren't with us, but never mind that! We're thinking about putting together a new expedition... Here's our company: Murk, Waterlily, and our new acquaintances - Skulnar, Eurial, Nogrom. Together we are a force to reckon with! But maybe we should take someone else with us! You, for example?

Those hunters invited us to join them! They say they have the best training on Kirah: there are wild demons everywhere, and you need to fight to survive! It's almost like the Winter Watch! We could fly there and compare experiences...

Who knows where all the waters end up, youngling? They used to flow into the seas, but there are no seas anymore. Who knows where they flow?

What was before, will happen again. What was today, will be tomorrow. The waters once whispered to me of cries over the canyon, of blood spilled down the slopes into the river. Yesterday, Nezeb walked here, today it's you, and tomorrow... who knows?

And the waters will always be here.
No, I can't do that yet...
When it's quiet, I tend to get bored, so I'm often starting fireworks!
Here it is. You should visit the Hangar Overseer next. Have a nice flight!
You won't hear me when I cut your throat...

We're always game for anything...

On the one hand, there is no war in the Empire at this time, and no war means no business for us thugs...

On the other hand, the rebel orcs do not pay us much either. Look around. What do they have here besides rags, trash, and scrap metal?

So our guys came up with this: they divided into two groups, one remained in the service of Xadagan, the others left to join the Arisen. That's how they operate. They don't fight each other, of course.
h: What do the Thugs think about the rebellion?

t:
Our clans include the Daring, the Insidious, the Ruthless, and the Silent... Yes, we have smaller numbers than the warriors and shamans, but we don't really work well in crowds. Our task is to sneak in unnoticed and cut our enemies' throats.

Each of us is an individual, each is a master of their craft. That's why being a member of our clan is not an honor, but a great benefit.
h: Which clans report to the thugs?

t: And what do I get? What valuables are you offering for my bugs and butterflies?

That's wonderful! Quarr!

My people love winged creatures and try to tame every kind. Ancient, strong Squawkers, or a fierce thunder-bird, or a clever parrot. But those who have feathers but do not fly? We don't consider them birds!

Do you understand that it's a big responsibility?
h: I want to take an egg

t: Do you want a Sign of the Chosen One?

h: Ask for a Sign of the Chosen One

t:
Oh, buddy! I'm glad to see you here! Yes, I've heard what happened in Eden, Ivan and Froddy told us everything. Oh, well. It doesn't negate everything you'd done earlier, right?

The Tycoon Club is ready to support you! You are too valuable to be discarded!

And we have a lot of things to do - the activity of pirates is growing, the dead are returning from the underworld, the Wormfaces and demons are still restless... But most importantly, something is happening to all the Great Trees of this world! This is terrible, because New Isa depends on the sapling of the Tree that is planted on Nordheim...

The Free Traders specialize in different fields. Mine is meteorite mining, Ivan's are trading ports, Ivlis trades in weapons, Hugh is in entertainment, Profka is in astral transportation, Victoria is in prohibited goods, Goblin Banker - in banking services.

Ah, silly Sparklet is surprised to see me here?

I was invited here. I was so bored there on the Secret Paths. Nobody solves my riddles.

Ah, silly Sparklet is surprised to see me here?

I was invited here. I was so bored there on the Secret Paths. Nobody solves my riddles.

And it's just running back and forth, back and forth, trying to fix something. It is not enough to cross the Bridge of Time, because there is also a Spinning Wheel, and a Wheel. And everything turns round.

If you break the Thread, sooner or later you will have to pay. Isn't that right, my little friend?

I am both the key and the lock, and what has not come true cannot come true. A piece of glass is spinning on a white hill, but the gaze of a blind man sees only a shadow. The one who has lost his home would like to build a new one, but without a home he is a wanderer. If you enter a river, you cannot enter the same river again.

If the pattern of the Spinning Wheel is outlined, it is too late to flip a coin. And the Wheel is deceptive, it goes up and down.

All Sparklets run to the Source, but not all are destined to reach it. Run, Sparklet, run along the path between the Stars. Can you make it in time?

Sweet sparks are coming to my Prism! They were lost on the Secret Paths... Poor things!

Will you play a game with me, sparks? If you win, I let you go. If I win, you will stay stray forever in my worlds. For I am the lock, and I am the key, and I make rules on the Secret Paths!

Why shouldn't I be standing here? Are you throwing me out? I have the right to be here after everything I've done for them. They put me here... so no one could see me. Just go away, would you? Don't piss me off.
What are you doing here? Get out.
I'm a Zverg! A mechanic from the workshop on Gelida. We have mines where we mine different ingredients for elves.

Warriors from our village could not stand idly by! We also believe in the Light, don't we? The Avatar of Light revealed the truth to us - if not for the Light, the whole world would be swallowed by Darkness, like Tequatl...

So far it's just me and Light-Ness, our priest, but soon many Tekyan warriors will arrive at Jigran! Praise the Sacred Fire!
...You managed to notice Nezeb's sharp blade as he drags it out of sheath.

My friends, I appreciate your care, but this is just too much. Wait outside, will you?

(Skrakan is speaking to the members of the Conclave)

Dear Council members, thank you for electing me, this is a great honor. It is with caution and unease that I accept your decision. I recognize the great responsibility you are endowing me with. I solemnly promise and swear to govern and rule justly and reasonably. I will not give you any cause to regret your decision.

With all due respect, may I ask who you are? Why did the guards let you in?!

I have to ask you to leave immediately, otherwise I will have to order the guards to arrest you.

Me and Murk just felt sad that you can't really have a good time here, and then we started talking, and it turned out that we both grabbed something from home...

Will you join us? Let's move to that spot under the stairs, have a drink...
h: What are you up to, Skulnar?

t:
Nothing good, that's for sure. Demons and demonologists tried to slit each other's throats with their bare teeth. There have been deaths. Mad demons were killed, but many "normal" fell... The demonologist team got smaller, too.

I could as well ask you what happened here. I arrived by the end of the show. Nogrom freaked out and summoned me. I put straight the cheekiest of them, but...

But there's something weird in their heads. I don't know how to describe it. The black... light? They're dim. I've never seen any such thing before.

quests: That is when the fun begins...

t: You'd better speak with Eladia. She's got a plan.
Something went wrong... Let's get you out!
I'm busy doing Nina's quest. Go and ask around about Alice and the chronophone. I'll find you when it's time, hah.
Yes, I'm ready... I just need a short breather. Whew, what a journey! It was a nightmare!

So this is what’s happened... If it hadn’t been for you, I would have died or gone crazy there? Well, well... Alright, friend, thank you. I don’t mind living a bit longer. You can always count on my help.
How do I know?! Let’s go take a look at the door - maybe we can figure it out.
h: Do you know the password to the reactor room?

t:
You want to talk? Well, why the hell not. Anyway, I have nothing else to do!

My name is Skulnar. From the Fierce clan. I’m here because I can fry up anyone’s brains in this steel cave, and also of every single creature in Nezebgrad. Without even lifting a finger. If you don’t believe me, you should ask those guys what happened to my ‘tester’ the other day. They are here to protect the world from me, huh.

I’m kidding, of course. I don’t give a dung heap about those skeletons in their coats and the white-skinned Imperial commanders in Yasker’s tower, bah! Why would I give them an easy death? I will let them kill themselves slowly in their beloved war - in the name of the Light, in the name of the Progress! D’oh! I have no one to fight for. The orcs have sold themselves to the Empire a long time ago. Nothing is left of their dignity.

So who are you? And why are you covering yourself with that coat?

I’ll be damned!

Of course I know I wouldn’t last long in here and I was thinking about escaping myself... But now the cavalry’s here, huh! You think I wouldn’t make it? What do you know. I’d kill all of them in a...

What do you mean, we can’t kill anyone?! Do you even know what they’ve done to me?

Ah, a new face. Let me take a look at you... Hm... I don’t get why they’ve sent you here. And what is going on inside your head. I used to see weird stuff like that when I was younger and I was fooling around with mushrooms... Is this your memory?

You’re one odd creature.

I can see stone beasts and a... square deity? The League and the Empire have joined their ranks - alright, this makes your cube god look as a pretty sober fantasy, huh! I can see the world dying in fire, and coming back as if nothing had happened. I can see you flying away from a six-pawed cat in an empty white world...

Alright, keep your memory away from me. It gives me headache.
